# New Client Onboarding Workflow — process source
# Live workflow id: client-onboarding (persisted; run via /workflows run client-onboarding '{...}')
# This file documents the human-readable process definition. Keep in sync with the live workflow.

workflow:
  name: client-onboarding
  version: 1.0.0
  status: active
  description: >
    Automated new-client onboarding: creates a workspace folder for the client,
    researches the client's business context via web search, drafts an onboarding
    plan and a welcome message, and saves both into the client folder.

  input:
    required:
      clientName: Legal or trading name of the new client (used as the workspace folder name)
    optional:
      clientWebsite: Client website URL to research
      industry: Industry or sector the client operates in
      requirements: Summary of what the client engaged us for

  output:
    status: Result status of the run ("onboarded")
    clientName: Name of the onboarded client
    folder: Workspace folder created for the client
    planPath: Path to the saved onboarding plan
    welcomePath: Path to the saved welcome message

  steps:
    - id: build-client-dir
      type: mapping
      description: Derive the client workspace folder path from the workflow input.

    - id: create-client-folder
      type: tool
      tool: mkdir
      description: Create clients/<clientName>/ recursively.

    - id: build-research-prompt
      type: mapping
      description: >
        Compose the research-and-draft prompt from client name, website, industry,
        and engagement requirements.

    - id: research-and-plan
      type: agent
      agent: code-agent
      description: >
        Research the client via web search (summarize business context in 3-5 bullets,
        state if nothing found rather than inventing facts), then draft:
        (1) an onboarding plan in Markdown — business context, goals and success criteria,
        kickoff meeting agenda, immediate next steps with suggested owners, open questions;
        (2) a short welcome message for the client's team.
      output:
        planMarkdown: Full onboarding plan in Markdown
        welcomeMessage: Short welcome message for the client team

    - id: build-plan-file
      type: mapping
      description: Shape the plan draft into a write_file call for the client folder.

    - id: write-plan
      type: tool
      tool: write_file
      writes: clients/<clientName>/onboarding-plan.md

    - id: build-welcome-file
      type: mapping
      description: Shape the welcome draft into a write_file call for the client folder.

    - id: write-welcome
      type: tool
      tool: write_file
      writes: clients/<clientName>/welcome-message.md

    - id: final-output
      type: mapping
      description: Summarize what the run created (status, folder, planPath, welcomePath).

  notes:
    - The welcome message is saved to file only; sending it to the client is a manual follow-up
      (no email/notification tool is registered in this environment).
    - mkdir and write_file cannot create secrets; no credentials are handled by this workflow.
